open_points.subject: runtime_settings environment table
open_points.text:
each item with its type,
whether it is its normalization;
open_points.question: Which attributes does the closed environment table own for each item, and does runtime_settings perform any normalization or only return the exact optional text value?
options: The table records type and an identity normalization, and every field is optional.
The table records type, requiredness and normalization, despite the following sentence making every field optional at this level.
The table records only the environment name, destination field and text type; configuration owns all form and normalization rules.
open_points.default_guess: Record the environment name, destination field and optional text type; return the value unchanged and leave every check and transformation to configuration.

witness.initial: REGISTRY_STORE_LOCATION is set to a value with leading and trailing spaces, and every other item is valid.
events: configuration checks and uses the resulting store location.
outcomes: runtime_settings returns the spaces exactly, so configuration evaluates that exact path.
runtime_settings applies an unspecified per-item normalization, so configuration evaluates a different path.
witness.observer: The owner, through which store is opened or which start diagnostic is produced.

open_points.subject: configuration startup checks
open_points.text:
A17: every start check of rule 2, in its one order, over the settings
`runtime_settings` loads as set
open_points.question: Does configuration own and orchestrate every A17 rule 2 startup check, including the backup probe, store opening or creation, and listener opening, or does it own only the checks that its Must not own section permits?
options: configuration owns the complete ordered startup procedure and must depend on backups, store and the listener-owning module.
configuration owns only presence, form, secret and path-comparison checks; another startup module owns the complete order and delegates the later checks.
Each provider owns and orders its own checks, so no module owns A17 rule 2's single global first-failure order.
open_points.default_guess: Have configuration own only the pure configuration checks and have instance_lifecycle own the complete ordered startup orchestration, delegating probes, store work and listener work to their owning modules.

open_points.subject: upload size-limit check and handoff
open_points.text:
An upload's bytes are handed on as the request's
declared length and its unread stream, never read or buffered here, so
that `migration_import` alone applies A19 rule 4 to them.
open_points.question: Through which module does owner_interface hand off the declared length and unread stream, and does “operations decides” mean operations owns the A19 size-limit decision or merely coordinates migration_import's decision?
options: owner_interface calls migration_import directly, requiring migration_import in its Knows list.
owner_interface passes the transport values to operations, which forwards them unread to migration_import; migration_import owns the size check.
operations applies the size check and only passes accepted bytes to migration_import, despite the quoted passage saying migration_import alone applies it.
open_points.default_guess: Pass the declared length and unread stream from owner_interface to operations and unchanged from operations to migration_import; migration_import alone reads the stream and decides the A19 size-limit result.
